ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the double solid lines represent the river channel, and the river channel is roughly in a curved belt shape; the legend shows that the dashed lines are "groundwater level contour lines." The dashed contour lines bend near the river channel, and the marked values gradually decrease from 25 and 24 on the left side to 23 on the right side. Then reason: The flow direction of groundwater should be perpendicular to the groundwater level contour lines and flow from high water level to low water level. The form of the groundwater level contour lines near the river channel in the figure indicates that groundwater converges toward the river channel, and the river is supplied by groundwater. This type of river-groundwater relationship is mostly seen in perennial rivers in humid or semi-humid areas. Among Chinese cities, Hefei is located in the Jianghuai region, has a relatively humid climate, and its rivers have water year-round, which best matches the relationship shown in the figure. Therefore the area where this river is located is most likely Hefei.
